title: Automated Sample Plating Protocol for 96-Well Plates
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Place tiprack and plate
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons tiprack in deck slot 3 and the 96‑well plate in deck slot 2.

steps.title: Place tube rack
steps.instruction: Place the Opentrons tube rack on the deck (slot not specified in the source text).

steps.title: Configure deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up your deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tipracks, and the pipette using the OT App (refer to support articles for calibration tips).
